name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Onboarding Project Manager | Hands-On Implementation, Training & Cross-Functional Coordination
summary: Implementation and onboarding project manager with 15+ years running client-facing technical projects end to end in B2B SaaS. Built sequenced implementation plans and guided API integrations at Accelo, directly managed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years at Wix while personally onboarding 25+ clients a month, and onboarded a network of 15-20 reseller partners at Birdeye (94% retention), coordinating cross-functionally with Product and Engineering the way this role expects. Configures CRM and automation systems hands-on for clients at Solenzo today, comfortable picking up a new, technical workflow quickly and training users directly on it.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own onboarding and technical configuration for a portfolio of B2B clients, running discovery and kickoff to translate each client's operations into a working CRM and automation setup.

Architect and implement complex CRM systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and data-hygiene protocols, configuring builds directly rather than handing off to a separate technical team.
Architected and deployed a complete GoHighLevel automation system, 20+ workflows spanning lead capture, booking, and post-sale onboarding nurture.
Deliver hands-on training and troubleshoot configuration issues directly with clients in real time.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable, managing multiple concurrent implementation projects at once.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Coordinated execution across internal departments as strategic lead, translating client requirements into aligned delivery plans.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94% retention), guiding each through complex technical setup and configuration of Birdeye's proprietary listings and reputation-management tools.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to resolve technical challenges and translate partner feedback into roadmap input, coordinating technical resources to keep integrations working smoothly.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (a team of 20, later a team of 8), running structured training and coaching across a high-value client portfolio.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Led hands-on training and digital growth consultations, guiding clients through setup and configuration directly.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, then handed off structured plans to the implementation team to execute.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, troubleshooting technical challenges during setup and building relationships with C-suite executives as a trusted advisor.
Escalated issues to leadership early and mitigated account-level risk with direct strategic guidance.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science — Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
